name: Writing Assistance
description: Windows MDM settings in the Writing Assistance category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Apps blocked by Writing Assistance admin policy (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows administrators to specify a list of applications where Writing Assistance will be blocked.
If you enable this policy setting, enter one application executable name per line (e.g., notepad.exe). Writing Assistance will be disabled in those applications.
If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, Writing Assistance will not be blocked by this policy in any application.

properties.name: Configure Writing Assistance installation and startup (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether Writing Assistance is not installed, installed without launching automatically at startup and locked off, installed without launching automatically at startup but still user-controllable, installed and allowed to launch automatically at startup and locked on, or installed with startup on by default but still user-controllable.

If you enable this policy setting, choose one of the following options:
- Not installed: Writing Assistance is removed and should not appear in Start.
- Installed, don't launch at startup: Writing Assistance remains installed, but automatic startup launches are blocked and users cannot turn startup back on.
- Installed, don't launch at startup by default (users can enable): Writing Assistance remains installed, automatic startup launches are off by default, and users can turn startup on later.
- Installed, launch at startup: Writing Assistance remains installed, automatic startup launches are allowed, and users cannot turn startup off.
- Installed, launch at startup by default (users can disable): Writing Assistance remains installed, automatic startup launches are on by default, and users can turn startup off later.

If you disable or don't configure this policy setting, Writing Assistance follows its default install and startup behavior, and users can control startup themselves.

Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise.

properties.name: Lock Writing Assistance admin blocklist (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether users can modify the admin-managed Writing Assistance blocklist.
If you enable this policy setting (or do not configure it), the admin blocklist is locked and users cannot remove entries from it.
If you disable this policy setting, users can remove individual entries from the admin-provided blocklist.

properties.name: Web pages blocked by Writing Assistance admin policy (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows administrators to specify a list of web page URL patterns where Writing Assistance will be blocked.
If you enable this policy setting, enter one URL pattern per line (e.g., example.com). Writing Assistance will be disabled on pages matching those patterns.
If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, Writing Assistance will not be blocked by this policy on any web page.

properties.name: Writing Assistance First Run Experience Mode (User)
properties.description: This policy setting controls the Writing Assistance first run experience (FRE).If you enable this policy setting, choose one of the following options:Skip FRE entirely - Writing Assistance marks the first run experience as completed without showing it.Informational only - Writing Assistance shows the first run experience once without requiring user approval or sign-in. The experience is marked completed immediately, uses Next on page 1 and Okay on page 2, removes No Thanks, and is still completed if the user dismisses it.Approval required - Writing Assistance keeps the existing approval-required first run experience behavior.If you disable or don’t configure this policy setting, Writing Assistance uses the existing default first run experience behavior.Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise.
